assumptions.description: Conditional natural-log insulin is Gaussian with constant residual variance; source arithmetic moments define unconditional log moments via lognormal identities. Individual residual draws are not parameter or transport uncertainty.

Approximate source age/BMI/glucose joint distribution is Gaussian. Age is independent of BMI and glucose. BMI-glucose covariance uses between-insulin-tertile means and n weights; unreported within-tertile covariance is set to zero, an explicit identifiability assumption.

BMI-insulin covariance uses only between-tertile mean products with n=110,107,104; within-tertile covariance is assumed zero. Under joint Gaussian log insulin and covariates, Cov(log insulin,X)=Cov(insulin,X)/E(insulin), then beta=Sigma^-1 c. Reported raw Pearson correlations are converted through this model, never copied as regression slopes.

Conditional sex difference is set to zero because compatible conditional sex evidence is absent. This is an assumption, not evidence of no sex effect. Sex-stratified generated analyses can reflect observed covariate distributions only.

Taiwan older East Asian non-diabetic volunteer relationships and Abbott insulin scale are transferred to heterogeneous US adults with a different Tosoh assay. Unit notation microU/mL equals uU/mL, but cross-assay calibration is not known. Clinical diabetes/medication mechanisms are unmeasured and not identified.

Above glucose 126 use 126+25*log(1+(glucose-126)/25); above BMI 40 use 40+10*log(1+(BMI-40)/10). Breakpoints/scales except glucose source exclusion threshold are conservative explicit assumptions that damp unsupported exponential extrapolation. They are not evidence of biological thresholds or validated nonlinear effects.

Source replay uses 10000 synthetic covariate rows, not patient records. Age rounded and restricted 50-79 to obey task bounds, approximating original 50-90 sample; BMI>=12 and glucose>=40 and <126 are assumed truncations. This changes moments. Sex is Bernoulli(.346) independently. Missing clinical selection criteria and covariate dependencies are not reconstructed.

Evidence variable labels age/BMI/fasting_glucose/fasting_insulin map by identity to task age_years/bmi_kg_m2/fasting_glucose_mg_dl/fasting_insulin_uU_ml. Unit spelling microU/mL is identical to uU/mL; kg/m2 to kg/m^2. Assay differences remain transport uncertainty.

Source tertiles are defined on reported insulin with low<=4.8, middle4.9-7.8, high>=7.9. Generated continuous values in decimal gaps are excluded in these diagnostic selections; no rounding is imposed.

beta_age_bmi_glucose.derivation: See static_derivation.json; weighted between-tertile covariance then multivariate Gaussian/lognormal moment inversion, with zero unreported within-tertile covariance.

male_log_shift.derivation: Explicit zero assumption, not a published zero effect.

high_glucose_extension.derivation: 126 is source exclusion boundary; 25 mg/dL tail scale is assumed.

high_bmi_extension.derivation: 40 kg/m^2 breakpoint and 10 kg/m^2 scale are assumptions.

source_context.derivation: Reported means/SDs/sex proportion; source row count, fixed covariate seed, truncations and missing dependencies are simulation design assumptions.
